title: Run a stdin program as C++ against the bundled runtime: java.text and Locale are missing, plus a method reference in an anonymous class
prompt: Make this program translate to C++ with J2C and run against J2C's bundled runtime, printing exactly what it prints on the JVM today for the input in input.txt. The j2c MCP tools are available; j2c_run translates, builds and runs the program and compares it with the JVM. Change only the Java sources.
